# Biblical Archaeology Society

> > Biblical Archaeology Society (BAS) publishes research, news, and discoveries connecting archaeology with biblical history across Israel, Jerusalem, and the ancient Near East.

Founded by Hershel Shanks, BAS publishes Biblical Archaeology Review (BAR) and provides scholarly articles, excavation reports, and cultural heritage news spanning periods from the Chalcolithic to Byzantine eras. The organization bridges academic archaeology with public interest in biblical sites, ancient inscriptions, and the material culture of ancient Israel, Canaan, and the broader Levant.

## Major Archaeological Discoveries

- [Tarshish: Hacksilber Hoards Pinpoint Solomon's Silver Source](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/news/tarshish-hacksilber-hoards-pinpoint-solomons-silver-source): Hacksilber hoards reveal Tarshish as Solomon's silver trade source
- [Have the Tombs of the Kings of Judah Been Found?: A Response](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/scholars-study/have-the-tombs-of-the-kings-of-judah-been-found-a-response): Scholarly response on discovery of Judean royal tombs in Jerusalem
- [Found After 1400 Years—The Magnificent Nea](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/biblical-sites-places/jerusalem/found-after-1400-years-the-magnificent-nea): Discovery of Byzantine Nea Church in Jerusalem after 1400 years
- [I Spy: A 3,500-Year-Old Ancient Egyptian Scarab](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/news/3500-year-old-ancient-egyptian-scarab): Thutmose III scarab discovered in Lower Galilee, Israel

## Biblical Sites and Excavations

- [Legio](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/biblical-sites-places/biblical-archaeology-sites/legio): Roman Sixth Ferrata Legion base excavation in Jezreel Valley, Israel
- [Tel Burna 2015: iPads, PlanGrid and GoPro](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/digs-2015/tel-burna-2015-ipads-plangrid-and-gopro): Digital archaeology tools at Tel Burna excavation using iPads & PlanGrid
- [Testimonials from the Field at Tel Kabri](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/tel-kabri/testimonials-from-the-field-at-tel-kabri): Student testimonials from Tel Kabri excavation with Minoan frescoes
- [Not Fit for a King?](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/news/not-fit-for-a-king): Controversy over Herod the Great's tomb attribution at Herodium

## Cultural Heritage and Museums

- [Sidon Archaeology Museum to Share Artifacts from the Biblical City](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/archaeology-today/cultural-heritage/sidon-archaeology-museum-to-share-a-new-view-of-ancient-saida): New Sidon Archaeology Museum to display Phoenician artifacts from Lebanon
- [The Cave of Elijah the Prophet under Threat?](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/news/the-cave-of-elijah-the-prophet-under-threat): Cave of Elijah at Mount Carmel, Haifa faces preservation threats
- [The Fabulous World of Agamemnon](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/exhibits-events/the-fabulous-world-of-agamemnon): Mycenaean Bronze Age exhibition at Badisches Landesmuseum, Karlsruhe
- [New App Provides On-Site Virtual Tour of Ruins](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/news/new-app-provides-on-site-virtual-tour-of-ruins): Architip AR app offers 3D virtual tours of Tel Lachish ruins

## Ancient Manuscripts and Scholarship

- [Tischendorf on Trial for Removing Codex Sinaiticus, the Oldest New Testament](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/archaeology-today/archaeologists-biblical-scholars-works/tischendorf-codex-sinaiticus-oldest-new-testament): Controversy over Tischendorf's removal of Codex Sinaiticus manuscript

- [How BAR Was Born](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/archaeology-today/biblical-archaeology-topics/how-bar-was-born): Hershel Shanks recounts founding of Biblical Archaeology Review magazine

## Book Reviews

- [The Bible and Archaeology](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/reviews/the-bible-and-archaeology): Review of Matthieu Richelle's work on biblical archaeology & epigraphy
- [In the Master's Steps](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/reviews/in-the-masters-steps): Review of Notley & Rainey's New Testament atlas on Jesus' ministry
- [The Norton Anthology of World Religions](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/reviews/the-norton-anthology-of-world-religions): Review of Norton Anthology of World Religions edited by Jack Miles
- [Lives in Ruins](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/reviews/lives-in-ruins): Review of Marilyn Johnson's book on archaeology profession & practice
